rationale:
Evidence from iteration 1 (score 574, the best so far): the oval finishes 80% of runs and the s-bend 65%, but the slalom never finishes (0%, mean progress 0.39, every run ends off track). Slalom max_error is about 0.064, above the 0.06 m off-track limit, with about 1.1 line-loss events per run. Body width cannot widen the limit: max(0.06, 0.0125 + body_width/4) is floored at 0.06 across the whole body range, so the fix has to come from tighter tracking. Steering oscillation (0.26 to 0.35) is already moderate, and kd went from 0.4 to 0.8 in iteration 1, which did not visibly add jitter.

Changes: (1) Raise kp from 4.0 to 4.5 to correct lateral error faster on the sharp slalom bends. The sensor array and kd are kept, since the sensor change was not isolated and kd 0.8 appears to be stable. (2) Lower base_speed from 1.5 to 1.4 to reduce lateral slip and sensor lag at the bends. Mean finish time on the s-bend was 2.45 s at 1.5, so this should give about 2.6 s, still inside the 3 s limit. Oval times (about 2.1 s) also stay within it.

Expected result: slalom progress rises above 0.39 and fewer off-track exits occur, s-bend completion improves, and oval completion holds. Hypotheses to test: (a) the extra kp reduces slalom max_error below 0.06; (b) the 1.4 base speed keeps finish times under 3 s on the s-bend; (c) steering_oscillation stays near or below 0.35 with kp 4.5.
